title: Merging Branches
introduction: You have built and tested your feature on its dedicated branch — now how do you bring those changes back into `main`? Today you learn **merging**: combining different branch histories, understanding Fast-Forward merges vs 3-Way merge commits, and deleting old branches cleanly.
why_it_matters: Merging is the culmination of the feature-branch workflow. Doing it cleanly ensures that the team's main codebase receives all your tested enhancements while keeping git history clear and traceable.
practical_activity_preview: Merge your feature branch into `main`, understand Fast-Forward, and safely delete the old branch.
